item.title: EU-Indonesia agreement sees the light after ten years of negotiations
item.description: The European Union and Indonesia have signed a major trade deal, ten years after talks began.The agreement removes almost all tariffs between the EU and Southeast Asia's biggest economy: 98.5 per cent of them. For Europe, it means access to a market of 280 million people and a steadier supply of nickel for batteries. For Indonesia, easier exports of palm oil, textiles and footwear, and it arrives just before its current EU trade preferences end on the 1st of January. To discuss the deal Airlangga Hartarto, Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs in Indonesia joined us on the programme. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Balochistan shutdown: Markets shut across Quetta as alliance protests rising inflation, insecurity
item.description: A significant shutdown swept across Quetta and several districts in Balochistan on Thursday, driven by widespread protests led by the All Parties Alliance. The strike aimed to highlight urgent issues such as deteriorating law and order, soaring unemployment rates, and rampant inflation. Major commercial hubs faced complete shutdowns, resulting in major disruptions. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Deal on duty-free Swiss exports to China a boon for Hong Kong, top diplomat says
item.description: The scrapping of tariffs on almost all Swiss exports to China will give Hong Kong’s finance, logistics and legal sectors a boost, the top Swiss diplomat in the city has said, as the European nation seeks more research and development (R&D) collaborations in the Northern Metropolis megadevelopment. Switzerland’s Consul General in Hong Kong Daniel Freihofer’s comments came after the presidents of the two countries met and signed an upgraded bilateral free trade agreement last month, among other... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
